    margin-bottom: 20px;
    border: 1px solid transparent;

/* Format Child Menu Items */

.gp-child-menu-grid {display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 24px;}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .gp-child-menu-grid {grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));}
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .gp-child-menu-grid {grid-template-columns: repeat(1, minmax(0, 1fr));}
}
/* Individual Grid Item Card */
.gp-child-menu-item {background: #ffffff; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; overflow: hidden;}
/* Link Wrapping Entire Card */
.gp-child-menu-item a {display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-decoration: none; color: #333333; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;}
/* Full Width Image Controls */
.gp-child-menu-img-wrapper {width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1200 / 800; overflow: hidden;}
.gp-child-menu-img {width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; transition: transform 0.3s ease;}
/* Text Content Padding Box */
.gp-child-menu-content {padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex-grow: 1;}
/* Menu Text Style */
.gp-child-menu-title {font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px; transition: color 0.3s ease;}
/* Page Snippet Text Style */
.gp-child-menu-snippet {font-size: 0.9rem; color: #666666; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0;}

.gp-child-menu-item:hover {transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);}
.gp-child-menu-item:hover .gp-child-menu-img {transform: scale(1.05);}

<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Notice to Public – Dates of Ordinary Meeting of Council 2026</strong></h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Pursuant to Part 2, Section 4 of the <em>Local Government (Meeting Procedures) Regulations 2025</em>, notice is hereby given that the Ordinary Monthly Meetings of the Tasman Council to be held in 2026 will be held at the following times and locations:</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>4th Wednesday at 5.00pm</strong> for the following months:</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">28 January, 25 February, 25 March,22 April, 27 May, 17 June, 22 July, 26 August, 23 September,28 October,25 November</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Meetings held on 28 January, 25 February, 25 March, 22 April will be held at Nubeena CWA, 1634 Main Road Nubeena and will commence at 5.00pm. Meeting held on 27 May will be held at Tasman Civic Centre 21 Clarke Street Nubeena.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">All meetings from June 2026 to be at Council Chambers, 1713 Main Road, Nubeena unless otherwise determined by Council.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Meeting to be held on 09 December commencing at 5.00pm will be preceded by the Tasman Council Annual General Meeting 2025, commencing at 4.30pm.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">All agenda papers will be available four (4) days prior to the meeting at the Council Office and on Councils website.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Blake Repine – CEO</strong></p>



<div style="height:48px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Agendas</strong> and <strong>Minutes</strong> are available by clicking the buttons below.</p>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Public Question Time</strong></h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Members of the public may address the Council during Public Question Time. In accordance with Regulation 36 of the <em>Local Government (Meeting Procedures) Regulations 2025</em>, Council will allocate a period of fifteen minutes for Public Question Time. The intention is to provide the public with an opportunity to come and ask a question directly to Council, information provided by Council to the public is not to be debated during the meeting. Council will determine any other procedures to be followed in respect of public question time at an ordinary council meeting.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Please see below Council’s <strong>Public Questions Time Policy and Form</strong> that sets out the procedures for the conduct of public question time at meetings of the Tasman Council.</p>
